shots.headline: Gerencie a rede de reciclagem
shots.sub: Máquinas, caminhões e um depósito na cidade
shots.scene: Harbour Quarter mid-day (~13:00), Medium tier, guide finished: 5 machines with in-world fill bars, a van on its route, citizens with bags walking to a machine, depot at the edge, HUD with cash, Green Rating and day clock

shots.headline: Esvazie antes de transbordar
shots.sub: Cada máquina mostra o quanto está cheia
shots.scene: Point sheet open on a machine at 92 % (red bar, 'Full — citizens are turned away' about to show), a citizen turning back with a bag beside it, other bars green/amber

shots.headline: Trace rotas econômicas
shots.sub: Cada quilômetro custa. Planeje o circuito.
shots.scene: Route being built: three machines tapped (numbered stops), route line on the roads, fuel badge showing the trip cost, Go button highlighted

shots.headline: Defina a regra de serviço
shots.sub: Esvazie em 60, 80 ou 95 %, ou só se chamado
shots.scene: Service rule sheet on a busy corner machine with 'Empty at 80 %' selected, Dispatcher hint line below

shots.headline: Conte, prense e venda fardos
shots.sub: Venda quando a cotação estiver boa
shots.scene: Depot tab: count line queue, baler with a PET bale, yard with stacked PET and aluminium bales, Sell button with today's price

shots.headline: Enfrente a onda de calor
shots.sub: Dias de jogo, congestionamentos e quebras
shots.scene: Heat wave event card on screen, machines filling fast (several amber bars), a second truck heading out, technician on the way to a jammed machine

shots.headline: Abra novos bairros
shots.sub: Centro Antigo, Colina da Universidade, estádio
shots.scene: Old Town just opened: narrow lanes with a cargo bike on an alley, café pickup point, toast 'Next district: University Hill'

shots.headline: Ganhe dias com três estrelas
shots.sub: Serviço, eficiência e fluxo no depósito
shots.scene: Day report with 3 stars, bottles collected, bottles per km, profit and Green Rating up (no rewarded-ad button in the frame)
